hints.title: Element Frequency
hints.text: Count how many times each integer occurs across the collection.

hints.title: Combinations Formula
hints.text: If a number appears c times, the number of distinct pairs (i, j) with i < j is given by c * (c - 1) / 2.

hints.title: Sum Over All Numbers
hints.text: Accumulate c * (c - 1) / 2 for every unique number in the frequency count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops take O(N^2) pairwise comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting frequencies takes O(N) time and space, computing combinations in O(1) per unique value.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies combinations formula c * (c - 1) / 2 rather than iterating over pairs.
complexity.notes: Pair ordering constraint i < j is inherent in combinations formula.
